purpose: Route child-rights, dignity, privacy and secure-development references without converting reference presence into compliance or certification.

authorities.authority: UN Committee on the Rights of the Child — General Comment No. 25 (2021)
authorities.scope: children's rights in relation to the digital environment, including networks, apps, connected devices, AI, algorithms, data analytics and biometrics
authorities.binding_force: AUTHORITATIVE_TREATY_INTERPRETIVE_GUIDANCE; legal effect depends on applicable treaty/state context
authorities.engineering_use: P0 protected-subject digital-rights and impact-analysis routing

authorities.authority: African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
authorities.scope: African regional child-rights framework; Article 2 defines child as under 18, Article 4 best interests, Article 10 privacy, with non-discrimination and cultural-rights context
authorities.engineering_use: do not erase cultural context; do not allow cultural labels or practices to override established child rights; require context provenance instead of stereotype

authorities.authority: Brazil LGPD Article 14 + ANPD Enunciado CD/ANPD No. 1/2023
authorities.scope: processing of personal data of children and adolescents in Brazil/applicable LGPD scope; best interest must prevail in the concrete case
authorities.binding_force: BINDING_WITHIN_LGPD_SCOPE; ANPD enunciado is regulatory interpretation
authorities.engineering_use: resolve legal basis, best interest, purpose, minimization, transparency and concrete data flow before child-data promotion

authorities.authority: South Africa Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 — sections 34-35
authorities.official_source: https://www.gov.za/ and official/public-sector copies of Act 4 of 2013
authorities.scope: processing personal information concerning children when POPIA applies; section 34 prohibition subject to section 35 authorisations/conditions
authorities.engineering_use: if South African child-data processing is actually established, require applicable authority/condition and safeguards before promotion

authorities.authority: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework Version 1.1
authorities.scope: secure software development practices and vulnerability-risk reduction
authorities.binding_force: TECHNICAL_GUIDANCE; contractual/regulatory force depends on incorporation
authorities.engineering_use: prepare organisation, protect software, produce well-secured software and respond to residual vulnerabilities using scoped receipts

authorities.authority: OWASP MASVS v2 privacy/security control families and current MASWE/MASTG evidence references
authorities.engineering_use: derive Android storage, network, platform, code, resilience and privacy negative-path tests

cross_cultural_context_gate.purpose: Preserve meaning and provenance without stereotyping or using culture as a shortcut around individual rights.

resolution_function_delta.resolve_subject: Establish whether a child/vulnerable/protected-subject use is real, potential or unknown; never infer from labels.
resolution_function_delta.resolve_jurisdiction: Resolve controller/provider/deployer, subject location, establishment/targeting, purpose and data flow separately.
resolution_function_delta.resolve_authority_hierarchy: Applicable law/regulation outranks private policy within scope; technical standards guide engineering but do not silently become law or certification.
resolution_function_delta.resolve_cultural_context: Require a traceable source/reference when cultural meaning changes a decision; otherwise preserve TOKEN_VAZIO_CONTEXT.
resolution_function_delta.resolve_evidence: Exact source, execution environment, test/inspection, artifact/device evidence, receipt and independent/legal review where applicable.
resolution_function_delta.promotion: Any missing gating input -> HOLD; claim_allowed remains false outside a bounded completed gate.
